feeds.title: The Foodie Takes Flight Blog
feeds.description: Jeeca, a 23-year old who loves sharing delicious vegan recipes. She shares mostly vegan Asian recipes and tofu dishes you can easily cook at home.

feeds.title: Vegan Richa
feeds.description: Richa creates flavorful plant-based recipes that are inspired by my Indian upbringing, including many gluten-free, soy-free, and oil-free options. Vegan Richa is a vegan food blog with Wildly flavorful and Inventive plant based recipes, often inspired from my Indian roots, to make you fall in love with cooking!

feeds.title: Okonomi Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lisa. Welcome to Okonomi Kitchen! Here you'll find delicious vegan recipes that are healthy, simple & easy to make. Also a bit of everything, but mostly feel-good recipes inspired by whole foods- mostly plant-based and usually gluten, oil & refined sugar-free. You'll probably find a lot of recipes from Japanese cuisine and other cuisines around the world.

feeds.title: The Korean Vegan Blog
feeds.description: The Korean Vegan is a food blog started by Joanne Molinaro in 2016. The Korean Vegan Blog consists of recipes that re-imagine traditional Korean meals through plant-based adaptations. In addition to recipes, the blog also features posts about Molinaro's life stories, reflections, and writing

feeds.title: Cheap Lazy Vegan Blog
feeds.description: My name is Rose - just an ordinary girl born in South Korea and raised in the beautiful country of Canada. Cheap Lazy Vegan Blog is for people who are cheap, lazy, and interested in the vegan lifestyle. Covers easy and affordable vegan meal ideas, low-calorie vegan recipes, Korean recipes, Asian recipes, vegan snacks, and vegan breakfast.

feeds.title: Mary's Test Kitchen
feeds.description: Simple, easy, delicious vegan recipes for vegans, vegetarians, and omnivores too! Chinese Canadian kitchen where you'll find vegan comfort food recipes developed from my favourite Chinese, Canadian, and more dishes, - simplified so they're easy to make in your kitchen without sacrificing flavour!

feeds.title: Pickled Plum
feeds.description: Caroline Caron-Phelps is a Japanese/French Canadian recipe creator, food blogger, and photographer. She showcases delicious, authentic Asian recipes, especially Japanese, vegan, and vegetarian, with beautiful photography, easy-to-follow instructions, videos, and practical recipe variations.

feeds.title: Veggie Anh
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Anh Tran. I am a food blogger, content creator, recipe developer and vegan foodie at VeggieAnh. On this blog you will find yummy recipes inspired by my Vietnamese background and international travels!

feeds.title: Veggiekins Blog
feeds.description: Vegan and gluten-free recipes and tips to live your best balanced and holistic life. Remy Park is a vegan recipe developer, food photographer, & blogger based in NYC.

feeds.title: Rainbow Plant Life
feeds.description: Created by Nisha Vora, a self-taught vegan chef, food blogger, photographer, and author of The Vegan Instant Pot Cookbook, Rainbow Plant Life is a vegan food and lifestyle website that features wildly flavorful recipes that will please vegans and non-vegans alike.

feeds.title: The Plant Based Wok
feeds.description: Here you'll find modern plant-based Asian recipes informed by tradition, to inspire you to live a more sustainable, meat-less lifestyle.

feeds.title: WoonHeng
feeds.description: Woon Heng shares Asian plant-based deliciousness that you can make in your kitchen. Her goal is to inspire you to try a meatless dish, one meal at a time.

feeds.title: No Sweat Vegan » Vegan Asian Recipes
feeds.description: Inspired by the cuisines of Thailand, China, and more, these Vegan Asian Recipes are simple and easy, yet bold and flavorful plant-based meals. Hi, I'm Julianne! I love creating simple and comforting vegan food for the whole family. Most of my recipes are healthy, Whole-Foods Plant-Based, and easy on the budget.

feeds.title: The Simple Veganista » Healthy Asian Recipes (Vegan)
feeds.description: A Vegan Food Blog. Inspiring simple, healthy and delicious plant-based recipes. Find a wide variety of healthy & easy Asian vegan recipes including soba noodles, tofu, miso and more! The Simple Veganista where you'll find healthy, affordable, easy vegan recipe everyone will love!

feeds.title: The Viet Vegan
feeds.description: The Viet Veganis a personal food blog by Lisa Le. Search for a delicious recipe. Explore Vietnamese, Gluten-free,Vegan recipes. My name is Lisa, I'm in my 30s, and I like taking pictures of food. I've been vegan since October 2013 and before that, I was vegetarian. While I no longer advocate cooking with dairy and eggs, I know that there are some people who have loved using the recipes on here.

feeds.title: It's Liz Miu
feeds.description: We do vegan and plant-based food here. Delicious recipes that are tasty, easy and nourishing for the soul. Recipes that hit the spot, you know? I've been plant-based for over 8 years now and love sharing my recipes with you all.

feeds.title: Astig Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to the blog, Astig Vegan! My name is RG Enriquez. I'm a cook and a purveyor of both traditionally vegan and veganized Filipino recipes. I believe that Filipino food can be vegan, healthy, and delicious, without losing its soul.

feeds.title: Sheil Shukla
feeds.description: Hi there! My name is Sheil and I am an internal medicine physician, artist, and cook. I live and work in the Chicagoland area, and I am passionate about plant-based nutrition and its applications to clinical medicine. I am the creator, recipe developer, and food photographer.

feeds.title: Plant-Based on a Budget » Vegan Asian Recipes
feeds.description: Make vegan Asian recipes for your family every day of the week. They will love all the fun new ways you prepare their favorites. Welcome to Plant-Based on a Budget! Here you'll find affordable and easy-to-make recipes, and an inclusive, supportive approach to plant-based eating.

feeds.title: Davina Da Vegan
feeds.description: Embracing the plant-based lifestyle in Malaysia. I'm Davina Goh, a performer and plant-based lifestyle advocate. This is my space to share recipes, green living tips, and places to find great plant-based food in the Klang Valley, where I live, and aim to expand this to other countries I get to travel to.

feeds.title: Omnivore's Cookbook » Vegan
feeds.description: Hi I'm Maggie Zhu! Welcome to my site about modern Chinese cooking - including street food, family recipes, and restaurant dishes. I take a less labor-intensive approach while maintaining the taste and look of the dish.
